verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de publishes public API documentation with concrete REST endpoints for notarization, incorporation, translation, tax registration and trade registration, plus HMAC-signed webhooks. It also serves an llms.txt for the API docs, which a probe confirmed. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all candidate paths returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of API use, and evidence on authentication and access, since at least the Compliance API is restricted to Enterprise plans.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: With Beglaubigt.de, businesses can submit documents, manage signers, and automate notarization workflows, or incorporate companies in Germany.
This endpoint creates a notarization request for a document
